content.text: Germinal or pregerminal B-cell malignancy originating in the lymphatic system
ETOH may induce lymph node pain
fever/chills, night sweats, weight loss, Pel-Ebstein fever
: ↑ age, HIV, EBV, HHV-8, H. pylori, autoimmune d/o
*immunocompromised pt (HIV) w/ GI sxs & painless peripheral LAD
•bone marrow: fatigue, easy bruising, recurrent infections
: non-contiguously to extranodal sites → skin, GI tract, brain
Burkitt: starry sky appearance on microscopy
CT: help establish stage based on extent of nodal & extranodal involvement
